headlines.title: Hackers attack and penetrate Air Force’s computing platform
headlines.description: Hackers penetrated the Air Force’s cloud computing platform in a breach that could have exposed sensitive military information, a U.S. official said Friday.

headlines.title: Severe storms upend Thanksgiving travel and leave hundreds of thousands without power
headlines.description: High winds and heavy rains hammered both coasts and hundreds of thousands remained without power after foul weather made for a miserable Thanksgiving for many.

headlines.title: Why Advent calendars are thriving in the ‘little treat’ economy
headlines.description: Creators on TikTok and Instagram are helping to fuel the advent calendar craze, one review video at a time.

headlines.title: Shop til You Drop: How to Get More Out of Black Friday Deals
headlines.description: With discounts everywhere you look, how can you tell if a sale is really worth your money? NBC business reporter Allie Canal joins TODAY with tips for a game plan to ensure you’re getting the most out of the Black Friday shopping frenzy, including using price trackers, cash-back programs and the kinds of deals consumers can find on everything from retail to travel.

headlines.title: Best Buy CEO on Black Friday Sales, Inflation, Hottest Items, More
headlines.description: Best Buy CEO Jason Bonfig joins TODAY with a look at what shoppers can expect on the busiest shopping weekend of the year that goes from Black Friday to Cyber Monday. He also weighs-in on inflation, the popular gifts of 2026, shopping in-store vs. online, and more.

headlines.title: Black Friday Shopping Weekend Kicks Off: What to Know
headlines.description: The busiest shopping weekend of the year is underway, with experts expecting Americans to spend a record $1 trillion despite concerns over inflation and nearly a year of high gas prices. NBC’s Brian Cheung reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Black Friday Shopping Strategy: Where and When to Shop
headlines.description: Black Friday is just two days away, and though some deals are already underway, NBC’s Vicky Nguyen joins TODAY to share where you can find the best savings and get the most out the annual holiday sale.

headlines.title: How grocery prices have changed since Trump took office
headlines.description: Learn where grocery prices stand during the Trump administration. See how inflation is affecting the cost of eggs, bread, chicken, ground beef and more.

headlines.title: Judge blocks FCC review of ABC station licenses for now
headlines.description: The Walt Disney Co. secured a temporary restraining order Wednesday blocking the Federal Communications Commission from moving forward with an unusually early review of ABC’s broadcast-station licenses, which the media company has called an attack on free speech by the Trump administration.

headlines.title: Tracking U.S., state and county gas prices, in maps and charts
headlines.description: Are gas prices declining? NBC News is tracking national, state and county prices at the pump.

headlines.title: Markets sell-off eases up, but AI doubts, tariffs and inflation still weigh down stocks
headlines.description: U.S. stocks declined Wednesday in a volatile day of trading that was led by companies linked to the AI boom.

headlines.title: Trump proposes a new wave of tariffs on China, E.U. and other trade partners
headlines.description: Trump proposes a new wave of tariffs on China, E.U. and other trade partners
